verified: Mercedes-Benz is preparing to roll out Drive Assist Pro to US and German customers with MB.OS vehicles, and Ars Technica was given a behind-the-wheel demonstration of the system, per the article.
unconfirmed: the rollout date, price, the specific models and trims that will receive the feature, and any independent measurement of its performance — the drive took place on a manufacturer-funded trip with flights and accommodation provided by Mercedes.

verified: 奔驰官方安排并提供给 Ars Technica 一次试驾，确认 Drive Assist Pro 面向运行 MB.OS 的车辆，计划在美国和德国向客户推送；该系统为 Level 2 级部分辅助驾驶，需驾驶员持续监督。
unconfirmed: 具体推送时间表、支持车型、选装或订阅价格均未披露；报道中的表现来自厂商主办的试驾，而非独立机构测量，其可靠性尚无第三方数据佐证。

titles.en: Mercedes preps Drive Assist Pro rollout for MB.OS cars in US and Germany
titles.zh: 奔驰 Drive Assist Pro 即将在美、德推送，Ars 实测城市复杂路况
